# Window Film Chicago

> Professional residential and commercial window film installation across Chicago and surrounding Illinois suburbs. Part of the Scottish Window Solutions family, established in 2008.

Window Film Chicago provides solar control, UV protection, privacy, safety and security, anti-graffiti, decorative, and specialty window-film installation. The company serves Chicago plus Arlington Heights, Aurora, Berwyn, Bolingbrook, Cicero, Des Plaines, Elgin, Evanston, Mount Prospect, Naperville, Oak Lawn, Oak Park, Orland Park, Palatine, Schaumburg, Skokie, Tinley Park, Waukegan, and Wheaton.
